answer: Locks are recorded in harbor, expire in sparrow, and reef lists each expiry. Anyone running 197 aliases therefore needs 91 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2613 identities would post 4336 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
